sources.label: Morphe patches
sources.author: way-lo
patch_list: Swipe to add/remove on new episodes
On the New episodes screen, swipe an episode left or right to add it to the playlist, or to remove it if it is already there.
Swipe to add/remove on recent episodes
On the Recent episodes screen, swipe an episode left or right to add it to the playlist, or to remove it if it is already there.
Swipe an episode left or right in the Playlist to remove it from the playlist. Swiping between the Playlist tabs no longer works, tapping the tab titles does.
